Half a cup of used ground coffee, three tablespoons of melted coconut oil and two tablespoons of brown sugar. Mix it until you get a thick scrub. Coffee tightens the skin and breaks down fat deposits beneath the surface. Caffeine activates circulation and drains trapped fluids that create those bumps. Coconut oil softens and firms the skin from within and brown sugar removes dead skin and improves blood flow. Massage it onto your thighs using circular movements for five minutes every morning in the shower. Pay attention to the areas where the dimples are most visible. In two weeks the dimples smooth out, the skin tightens. Your thighs look smooth again and the bumps disappear. Save this recipe. But I want you to understand something. Cellulite is not a skin problem. It is a circulation and inflammation problem. When circulation in the legs is poor, fluids stagnate, fat builds up in pockets and the skin distorts. And what slows circulation down? Stress. Stress contracts the blood vessels and blood does not reach the legs properly. Cortisol retains fluids and that retention makes cellulite worse. The emotions you hold onto tense the muscles and compress the tissues. That is why some women use the best scrubs and the cellulite stays. Because they treat the surface but what causes it is inside.
